data.description: The root: { id, label, value?, color?, children? }. A branch's value is the sum of its children.

label.description: What the whole is. Names the chart for assistive technology.

formatValue.description: Formats sizes on tiles, the total, and the tooltip.

colorLabel.description: Names the shading measure, such as "Growth". Tiles take the hue of their top level branch and deepen with the measure. Leave it out for one depth.

colorDomain.description: Range of the shading measure. Defaults to the range of the leaves.

focus.description: Controlled id of the node that fills the view.

defaultFocus.description: Initial focus when uncontrolled. Defaults to the root.

onFocusChange.description: Called when people drill in or out.

height.description: Height of the tiles in pixels.

emptyLabel.description: Shown when every value is zero.
